chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazeed ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamza, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a woman who was divorced and had reached an advanced age, she menstruated once, then her menstruation ceased. He (peace be upon him) said: She should observe the waiting period with that one menstruation and two following months, for she has despaired of menstruation (reached menopause).
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a divorced woman who has reached menopause?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the iddah for a divorced woman who has reached menopause (yastahi al-mahid), ruling that her waiting period consists of one menstruation followed by two lunar months. This specific calculation addresses the legal nuance of irregular or ceased menstruation, ensuring the certainty of non-pregnancy in the absence of regular cycles. It reflects the Shia juristic approach to adapting general Quranic injunctions to specific physiological conditions.
